emotional_tone: Trustworthy, Warm, Professional, Energetic but Organized
design_context: SaaS Platform & Landing Page (Business Management System)

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large display numbers, hero section

body.usage: Paragraphs, lists, data tables, secondary text

mono.usage: Metrics, ID numbers, timestamps, system statuses

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy - use 2x more padding than typical SaaS to create a calming, unpretentious experience.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid (Dense, functional): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
spacing_and_layout.landing_grid: Bento Grid (Asymmetrical): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl (8px to 12px max for a soft, tactile feel, avoiding hyper-rounded pill shapes)

surface_styles.cards: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#E5E3DB] rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
surface_styles.interactive_widget: bg-[#F9F8F6] border border-[#E5E3DB] rounded-xl hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#1A4331]/30 transition-all duration-300
surface_styles.header_nav: bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5E3DB] sticky top-0 z-50
surface_styles.hero_overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1A4331]/80 via-[#1A4331]/40 to-transparent (Never flat black for this earthy theme)

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A4331] text-white hover:bg-[#265C45] rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1A4331] border border-[#1A4331] hover:bg-[#E8F0EC] rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#E06D53] text-white hover:bg-[#C95A41] rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-white border border-[#E5E3DB] rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 focus:border-[#1A4331] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1A4331] outline-none transition-all
components.badges: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium tracking-wide
components.icons: lucide-react (using crisp, clear stroke widths, typically size 20 or 24)
components.forms: Use Shadcn components highly customized to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Use the earthy border colors and generous internal padding.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have a subtle hover state (background color shift, slight translation for cards, or border color change).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-out for standard interactions. duration-500 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1)] for page sections or modals.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-in for dashboard widgets (using framer-motion if possible, or css animations).

hero_landing.description: Person walking a pack of dogs in a park
hero_landing.usage: Landing page hero section background or prominent side image.

client_dashboard_banner.description: Happy golden retriever sitting in a field
client_dashboard_banner.usage: Client dashboard empty state for 'No dogs registered' or top welcome banner.

walker_abstract_bg.usage: Walker profile background cover or login/register split screen background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Organic & Earthy' archetype. Do not use generic SaaS blues or pure dark mode grays.
Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios against the off-white backgrounds.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their default styling in tailwind.config.js and globals.css to match these design guidelines.
Every page must have a visible navigation bar (Header). No transparent headers without a backdrop-blur and semi-solid background.
For the Landing Page, use the 'Bento Grid' strategy. Break symmetry. Use overlapping elements.
For the Dashboards (Admin, Walker, Client), use the 'Control Room Grid'. Keep widgets dense but internally well-padded.
Implement data-testid attributes on all interactive elements using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'book-walk-button').
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the exact image URLs provided in this JSON.
For charts, use Recharts with the defined brand color palette (Primary Green, Terracotta, Ochre, Sage).
Do not use the Inter font. Import and use Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text via Next.js next/font/google.
